_note: Sprungplatten (src/hell/launch_pads.gd, placed in the Weltbauer): a pad throws the hero `cells` cells in its direction. air_base + air_per_cell * cells = seconds in the air; height_base + height_per_cell * cells = height of the arc in world px; reach = half size in px of the spot that fires it, measured from the pad's middle; windup = seconds on the pad before the throw, so it is seen and heard; default_cells and max_cells bound the Weltbauer's choice; step = px the landing search goes back when the wanted spot is blocked; shake = camera jolt on landing. preview_cells: how near (in cells) the hero must stand to see where a pad throws, preview_dot_cells the space between the dots of its arc, preview_color their colour, preview_mark the radius in px of the ring at the landing spot.
